name: nowitknows
description: NowItKnows for Claude Code: skill-use protocol and router, past-session search, global memory, and background skill learning reviewed by an adversarial judge.

metrics.title: Local session counts
metrics.description: Collect local token and session counts for the report. No conversation text is stored in metrics.

review.title: Background learning
review.description: Run background reviews that update skills and memory (uses your Claude plan).

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model that proposes skill and memory updates.

judge_model.title: Judge model
judge_model.description: Model that adversarially reviews each background skill change and project note before it applies.

os_notify.title: Desktop notifications
os_notify.description: Also send NowItKnows change notices as terminal desktop notifications (OSC 9).

allow_extra_usage.title: Learn while extra usage is on
allow_extra_usage.description: Run background learning while paid extra usage is on for your Claude account; runs past your plan's limits are then billed as extra usage. Off keeps learning inside your plan: reviews in an open session pause at your plan's limits, and reviews outside a session pause while extra usage is on, or wherever Claude Code has not cached your account details (always with a `claude setup-token` login).

share_project_notes.title: Share project notes
share_project_notes.description: Share project notes between Claude Code and Codex in Claude's memory folder for each repo. This option changes Claude Code only; in Codex use the NowItKnows setup skill's configure share_project_notes=off, or run /nowitknows:setup --separate-notes to set both.

bounded_review_skills.title: Trim skill text in reviews
bounded_review_skills.description: Background reviews in a session paste the full text only of skills the session loaded and skills NowItKnows may change; your other skills keep their one-line listing. Off pastes every listed skill while room allows. This option changes Claude Code only; in Codex use the NowItKnows setup skill's configure bounded_review_skills=off.
